notes: FLAGS. QWEN_FAST_TP4_SHARD_ARGMAX and _AUDIT exist (tp4_sampdraft). QWEN_FAST_TP4_SHARD_ARGMAX_FOLD2 is NEW and read only by tp4_shard_argmax.fold2_enabled (strict 0/1, raises at the pair and without S1; reserve() raises at the block warm). tp4_sampdraft.py (shared) does not know it: add it to ALL_FLAGS and pair it with SHARD_ARGMAX in validate() the way AUDITS pairs an audit with its lever, so an arm that sets FOLD2 without S1 fails at attach. SMOKE. The generated tables carry the three-marker rule (S1's flag is dispatched statically already). The stricter rule - fold=1|2 matching the profile, words=1, tasks=2*workers, an audit line for chips=4, no lines without the lever - is scripts/ci/tp4_shard_argmax_smoke.py problems(env, container_text), a host-side module (not an image file) for c2_smoke_check.fusion_problems to call once per arm. IMAGE. fold2.cpp only; tp4_shard_argmax.py and _fold.cpp changed in place. tp_addresses: none (three (1,1,1,64) outputs and two reserved scratch buffers, no L1 table). W3-MR LAYOUT (the one both use): per chip three ROW_MAJOR DRAM tensors of one 64-word page, shape (1,1,1,64), the same on every chip: ids uint32 (256 B), values bf16 (128 B), words uint32 (256 B) = (column << 16) | bits, rows >= rows zero. MR's two-read arm (tp4_mesh_read.read_predictions on ids and values) needs no change; its word arm reads tp4_shard_argmax.words_for(output[2]) once with the same ConcatMeshToTensor(dim=0) composer and decodes each chip's rows with tp4_shard_argmax.decode_words(rows_slice, block_rows) (handles the sign bit of columns >= 32768). The words tensor is freed by tp4_shard_argmax.release_audit, which packed_verifier.release_sampdraft_audit already calls per trace output: MR must not free it. GRID. The scan uses every worker the device reports (110 on 11x10, 130 on 13x10): 220 or 260 tasks, runs of 17-18 or 14-15 tile columns, a scan about 15 percent shorter on 13x10; the partials buffer is (1,1,2*workers,32), the one-core fold's CB and FOLD_MAX_PAGES define follow it (17 CB pages at 260 pages) and it gets 18 percent slower with the extra records, the tree fold's level-1 blocks grow from 28 to 34 pages on the same eight cores; the engaged marker reports workers=<W> tasks=<2W>; answers do not depend on the grid; a grid under 108 workers (runs over 18 tile columns) is a logged fall-back to the served path. v678's profile on the unlocked cards (ArgMax 945 -> 877 us on 130 cores) is the served path S1 replaces.
